metadata.question: Is Lake Langano more brown than Lake Abijata in March 29, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) because it has 20 m “red-edge”/SWIR bands and is available for 2022-03-29. - Define a ±1-day window around 2022-03-29 (i.e. 2022-03-28 → 2022-03-30) to guarantee at least one scene. - Two separate Point geometries placed on Lake Langano and Lake Abijata (Ethiopian Rift Valley). 2. Masking strategy: - Apply the Sentinel-2 QA60 cloud mask (using the 10th bit). - Compute a “brownness” proxy: Normalized Difference Turbidity Index (NDTI = (B4 – B6)/(B4 + B6)) which uses the green (B3) and SWIR (B6) bands and is strongly correlated with suspended sediments / brown colour. - Take the spatial mean NDTI inside a 1 km radius buffer around each lake point. 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero from null/error: - Check collection size; if zero → C1. - After masking, count valid pixels with ee.Reducer.count(); if zero → C2. - If computed mean NDTI is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise compare means: – If Langano NDTI > Abijata NDTI → A (Yes, Langano is more brown) – Else → B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time ptL = ee.Geometry.Point(38.75, 7.60) # Lake Langano ptA = ee.Geometry.Point(38.65, 7.65) # Lake Abijata roiL = ptL.buffer(1000) roiA = ptA.buffer(1000) date = '2022-03-29' # 2. Data acquisition def get_ndti(roi): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2022-03-28','2022-03-30')) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, 0 img = (col .map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0))) .median()) ndti = img.normalizedDifference(['B4','B6']).rename('ndti') cnt = ndti.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndti').getInfo() if cnt == 0: return None, 0 val = ndti.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndti').getInfo() return val, cnt ndtiL, cntL = get_ndti(roiL) ndtiA, cntA = get_ndti(roiA) # 3. Validation & Answer print(f"Langano NDTI: {ndtiL:.3f} Pixels: {cntL}") print(f"Abijata NDTI: {ndtiA:.3f} Pixels: {cntA}") if ndtiL is None or ndtiA is None: print("C2") else: print("A" if ndtiL > ndtiA else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
ptL = ee.Geometry.Point(38.75, 7.60)   # Lake Langano
ptA = ee.Geometry.Point(38.65, 7.65)   # Lake Abijata
roiL = ptL.buffer(1000)
roiA = ptA.buffer(1000)
date = '2022-03-29'

# 2. Data acquisition
def get_ndti(roi):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
             .filterBounds(roi)
             .filterDate('2022-03-28','2022-03-30'))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None, 0
    img = (col
           .map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0)))
           .median())
    ndti = img.normalizedDifference(['B4','B6']).rename('ndti')
    cnt = ndti.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndti').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0:
        return None, 0
    val = ndti.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndti').getInfo()
    return val, cnt

ndtiL, cntL = get_ndti(roiL)
ndtiA, cntA = get_ndti(roiA)

# 3. Validation & Answer
print(f"Langano NDTI: {ndtiL:.3f} Pixels: {cntL}")
print(f"Abijata NDTI: {ndtiA:.3f} Pixels: {cntA}")

if ndtiL is None or ndtiA is None:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if ndtiL > ndtiA else "<answer>B</answer>")
